notes.title: Hotfix - 1
notes.notes:
Fixed a critical bug in the ‘Commander’ boss battle
Drones flying vertically on the highest difficulty are not destroyed

notes.title: We are pleased to present you an updated demo version of our game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/cdb2b903f6e0fcc802c3fc593f90386adf569cb6.gif[/img]
Localisations in Portuguese-Brazilian, Chinese (simplified) and Russian have been added. Machine translation was used for translation, so there may be some inaccuracies in the text.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/0d18e793038506c34e03f0bf34831632ecc04095.gif[/img]
Platforming mechanics have also been improved: now the player has time to jump if he accidentally slips off the platform.
In addition, we fixed the mechanics of sliding, which can now be activated by a separate button. This makes it much easier to perform difficult jumps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/cc39cc54a6c8996d5fe36ae7db8e1bb9edcd5757.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/7c171e6653795af73b059d319357dcfd8d01a92a.gif[/img]
Shooting upwards and fixing the character's rotation has also been added.

[h3]The game is scheduled for release on November 19.[/h3]
